arxiv-1903-01538.description: Abstract Identifying dense bipartite subgraphs is a common graph data mining task. Many applications focus on the enumeration of all maximal bicliques (MBs), though sometimes the stricter variant of maximal induced bicliques (MIBs) is of interest. Recent work of Kloster et al.

arxiv-2110-05265.title: Optional Pólya trees: posterior rates and uncertainty quantification Thanks: Submitted to the editors October 2021.
arxiv-2110-05265.creator: Ismaël Castillo, Thibault Randrianarisoa
arxiv-2110-05265.description: Abstract We consider statistical inference in the density estimation model using a tree–based Bayesian approach, with Optional Pólya trees as prior distribution. We derive near-optimal convergence rates for corresponding posterior distributions with respect to the supremum norm. For broad classes of Hölder–smooth densities, we show that the method automatically adapts to the unknown Hölder regularity parameter.

The first and last authors are partially supported by EPSRC grant EP/T015713/1. The last author also thanks the partial support of Austrian Science Fund (
arxiv-2302-06814.creator: 1 st James H. Davenport, 2 nd Zak P. Tonks, 3 rd Ali K. Uncu
arxiv-2302-06814.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by 1 st James H. Davenport, 2 nd Zak P. Tonks, 3 rd Ali K. Uncu. Cylindrical Algebraic Decomposition (CAD) was the first practical means for doing Real Quantifier Elimination (QE), and is still a major method. Nevertheless, its complexity is inherently doubly exponential in the number of variables. Where applicable, virtual term substitution (VTS) is more effective, turning a QE problem in n n variables to one in n − 1 n-1 variables in one application, and so on.

arxiv-2305-15321.title: Towards Foundation Models for Relational Databases [Vision Paper]
arxiv-2305-15321.creator: Liane Vogel, Benjamin Hilprecht, Carsten Binnig
arxiv-2305-15321.description: Abstract Tabular representation learning has recently gained a lot of attention. However, existing approaches only learn a representation from a single table, and thus ignore the potential to learn from the full structure of relational databases, including neighboring tables that can contain important information for a contextualized representation.

arxiv-2306-02506.title: High-field phase diagram of the chiral-lattice antiferromagnet Sr(TiO)Cu 4 (PO 4 ) 4
arxiv-2306-02506.creator: Toshihiro Nomura, Yasuyuki Kato, Yukitoshi Motome, Atsushi Miyake, Masashi Tokunaga, Yoshimitsu Kohama, Sergei Zherlitsyn, Joachim Wosnitza, Shojiro Kimura, Tsukasa Katsuyoshi, Tsuyoshi Kimura, Kenta Kimura
arxiv-2306-02506.description: Abstract We studied the high-field phase diagram of a chiral-lattice antiferromagnet Sr(TiO)Cu 4 (PO 4 ) 4 by means of ultrasound, dielectric, and magnetocaloric-effect measurements. These experimental techniques reveal two new phase transitions at high fields, which have not been resolved by previous magnetization experiments.

arxiv-2402-06505.title: The role of mobility in epidemics near criticality
arxiv-2402-06505.creator: Beatrice Nettuno, Davide Toffenetti, Christoph Metzl, Linus Weigand, Florian Raßhofer, Richard Swiderski, Erwin Frey
arxiv-2402-06505.description: Abstract The general epidemic process (GEP), also known as susceptible-infected-recovered model (SIR), describes how an epidemic spreads within a population of susceptible individuals who acquire permanent immunization upon recovery. This model exhibits a second-order absorbing state phase transition, commonly studied assuming immobile healthy individuals.

arxiv-2412-15861.title: On Robust Cross Domain Alignment
arxiv-2412-15861.creator: Anish Chakrabarty, Arkaprabha Basu, Swagatam Das swagatam.das@isical.ac.in
arxiv-2412-15861.description: Abstract The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distance is an effective measure of alignment between distributions supported on distinct ambient spaces. Calculating essentially the mutual departure from isometry, it has found vast usage in domain translation and network analysis. It has long been shown to be vulnerable to contamination in the underlying measures.

arxiv-2503-03515.title: DO-IQS: Dynamics-Aware Offline Inverse Q-Learning for Optimal Stopping with Unknown Gain Functions
arxiv-2503-03515.creator: Anna Kuchko
arxiv-2503-03515.description: Abstract We consider the Inverse Optimal Stopping (IOS) problem where, based on stopped expert trajectories, one aims to recover the optimal stopping region through the continuation and stopping gain functions approximation. The uniqueness of the stopping region allows the use of IOS in real-world applications with safety concerns.

arxiv-2508-17100.title: Elementary divisor rings with Dubrovin-Komarnytsky property Thanks: Corresponding Author: V. Bovdi
arxiv-2508-17100.creator: Victor Bovdi and Bohdan Zabavsky
arxiv-2508-17100.description: Abstract . We introduce noncommutative rings with D ​ K DK -property (Dubrovin-Komarnytsky’s property) and investigate elementary divisor rings with such property. Mostly we pay attention to these kinds of noncommutative rings which have stable range 1 1 . A theory of reduction matrices over such rings is constructed.

arxiv-2509-09205.title: Fragmented Spin Liquid and Shadow Pinch Points in Dipole-Octupole Pyrochlore Spin Systems
arxiv-2509-09205.creator: Daniel Lozano-Gómez, Han Yan (闫寒)
arxiv-2509-09205.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Daniel Lozano-Gómez, Han Yan (闫寒). We study the classical dipole-octupole pyrochlore spin systems in an external magnetic field along the [ 111 ] [111] direction. We identify an intermediate fragmented spin liquid phase that precedes full spin saturation, characterized by the coexistence of three phenomena: U(1) spin liquid on the Kagome planes, spontaneous ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} symmetry breaking, and partial spin polarization from explicit symmetry breaking.

britannica-1911-jacob-of-juterbogk.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-jacob-of-juterbogk.description: Article 'Jacob of Jüterbogk' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Benedict Stolzenhagen, known in religion as Jacob, was born at Jüterbogk in Brandenburg of poor peasant stock. He became a Cistercian at the monastery of Paradiz in Poland, and was sent by the abbot to the university of Cracow, where he became master in philosophy and doctor of theology. He returned to his monastery, of which he became abbot.

pmc-12691756.title: Correlation Between Body Plethysmography and Impulse Oscillometry Across Obstructive and Restrictive Lung Diseases: Evidence from an Adult Pilot Study Cohort
pmc-12691756.creator: Eugenia Corina Budin, Ioan Vladimir, Ruxandra Mioara Râjnoveanu, Dragoș Huțanu, Mara Andreea Vultur, Corina Mărginean, Sofia Teodora Muntean, Edith Simona Ianoși, Gabriela Jimborean, Ovidiu Simion Cotoi
pmc-12691756.description: Background/Objectives: Despite the complementary insights provided by body plethysmography and impulse oscillometry, direct comparisons across obstructive and restrictive lung diseases remain limited. The aim of this study was to evaluate correlations between plethysmographic and oscillometric parameters, with a particular focus on hyperinflation and small airway dysfunction.

pmc-13032925.title: Role of the primate ventral striatum as a neural hub bridging option valuation and action selection
pmc-13032925.creator: Masafumi Nejime, Mengxi Yun, Yawei Wang, Takashi Kawai, Jun Kunimatsu, Hiroshi Yamada, Ken-ichi Inoue, Masahiko Takada, Masayuki Matsumoto
pmc-13032925.description: Making appropriate decisions relies on the brain’s capacity to evaluate the expected outcomes of available options and select the most rewarding action. The ventral striatum and midbrain dopamine neurons have been implicated in the option valuation process, consistent with the brain’s reinforcement learning theory in which these brain structures encode and update value representations of expected outcomes.

pmc-13434039.title: Integrated single-cell and spatial transcriptomics reveal stromal–immune–vascular crosstalk in patients with interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome
pmc-13434039.creator: ByulA Jee, IJun Kim, Cheol Lee, Yeon Jeong Kim, Kyunghee Park, Ji-Hee Sung, Inwoo Hwang, Jung-Sun Kim, Kyu-Sung Lee, Kwang Jin Ko, Minyong Kang
pmc-13434039.description: Interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome (IC/BPS) is characterized by complex cellular heterogeneity and inflammatory dysfunction in the bladder. However, the molecular pathogenesis of IC/BPS remains poorly understood, and few studies have provided comprehensive analyses. To elucidate the mechanisms underlying disease pathology, we performed integrated single-cell and spatial transcriptomic analyses of human bladder tissue.

pmc-13581371.title: Collagenase Versus Operative Management for Dupuytren Contracture: A Propensity-matched Cohort of 16,888 Patients
pmc-13581371.creator: Yousef Tanas, Stephen Chen, Peter Zak, Hamza Bhatti, Samantha Cervantes Valadez, Keyvon Rashidi, Joshua Wang, Philong Nguyen, Sarya Swed, Shari R. Liberman, Anthony Echo
pmc-13581371.description: Background:Dupuytren contracture (DC) is a fibroproliferative disorder of the palmar fascia, commonly managed through enzymatic collagenase injections or surgical interventions such as fasciotomy or fasciectomy. This study aims to compare clinical outcomes and complication rates between patients undergoing collagenase injection and those receiving surgical treatment for DC.
